snippet.title: A Tiny Wander - 2nd Trailer
snippet.description:
▼Wishlist Now On Steam
[ A Tiny Wander（ア・タイニーワンダー）]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3260830/A_Tiny_Wander/

とある涼しい夏の夜の、ちょっと不思議な3D謎解きアドベンチャー。
テントを張ったはいいけれど…こんな満月の夜には何かが起きそうだ！

A Slightly Mysterious 3D Puzzle Adventure on a Cool Summer Night
You've pitched your tent—but on this full moon night, something is bound to happen!

#gamedev #wholesomememes #ATinyWander
